title: Drone Footage, AI searches and Axon FUSUS audit logs

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1) All drone footage filmed on November 13th 2026.

2) All drone tracks for November 1st to 20th in GPX format or similar (coordinates, elevation and timestamp at ~1 second interval).
    CAD report related to each drone outing and a way to link the report to the track. (Some kind of id or in the file name)

3) From January 2025 to present, CSV or excel list of AI searches (ex: AXON FUSUS Dynamic AI or others) with the fields:
- Search date ex: 11/20/2026.
- Searched by ex: Devin Lay.
- Detection Type ex: Person, Vehicle, Object, Other.
- Additional filters ex: car color, make, body type, license plate search.
- Search window (Start time, End Time).
- Devices searched ex: 124 security cameras, 2 drones, 34 Body worn cameras, 22 dash cams, 40 private cameras (FUSUS One).
- Reason ex: Hit and Run.
- Case number.

4) From January 2025 to present, CSV or excel list of FUSUS Sentry rules with fields:
- creation date: 11/20/2026
- deletion date
- Area (for circle: coordinates + radius, for polygon: List of coordinates)
- created by ex: Devin Lay
- object type (e.g., person, vehicle)
- visual filters (e.g., clothing color, size, ...)
- schedule (e.g., days, hours of activity)
- trigger an alert when a match is found ex: True or False
- trigger timestamps: List of date + time

5) As of 11/20/2026, a CSV or excel list of FUSUS One / Community cameras / "Works with Fusus" cameras with fields:
- coordinates
- date added
- owner ex: QuikTrip
- live access: True or False

6) From January 2025 to present, Audit logs of License Plate Reader (LPR / ALPR) searches on FUSUS in a machine readable format. ex CSV

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Moreno Morales
